_: Blue Skies, from All the Mods 9's census (W4 R7, judged 2026-11-11). Crystal sandstone and midnight sandstone are the natural rock under the Everdawn's and the Everbright's sands, as vanilla sandstone is, and taratite and umber the natural rock of their ground; the rules leave them out for the decorative word in sandstone, or for having no stone word. Named one by one, only the blocks that census saw as ground and judged, because a word a rule could read would take other mods' blocks with it, and because a file reaches a config that already holds detection's line where a changed rule does not. Their cut, smooth, chiseled and polished forms, pillars, slabs, stairs and walls were not judged and are left to the rules, and the dimensions' stones, dirts, grasses and sands that detection already places are left to it.

A slab or stair takes its full block's ruling (Xep, 2026-11-13: Can we make it so all slabs of blocks that wear, also wear, in their own like the full blocks do? and: Same with stairs as slabs; W4 R15). These are this mod's slabs and stairs whose full blocks a census of 1.20.1 judged, each named at its full block's family so it wears on its own texture as the full block does. A slab or stair of a block the census excluded, or never judged, is left as it was. Where an earlier note here leaves this mod's slabs and stairs to the rules, or to detection's family, the ones named below no longer are.
